authorization: User requested continuous work for approximately five to six hours and a staged review afterwards.

rounds.question: Does the static hypercube assignment match actual near-boundary swaps and observed perturbations?
deliverables: analytic utility and exact replacement checks

rounds.question: Can low-cost input-only models predict conditional expert utility rather than label-aware oracle choices?
deliverables: matched classical and quantum predictors across three seeds

rounds.question: Can the learned information improve deployed routing under matched information and parameter budgets?
deliverables: controlled residual or replacement routing confirmation if internal-dev signal supports it
all preserved failures and negative decisions

rounds.question: Are effects reproducible, material and affordable within the measurement scope?
deliverables: plots and Chinese Markdown/Typst/PDF stage report

rounds.question: Repair or investigate concrete anomalies without mixing protocols.

constraints: No modification of frozen round-one sources/configs/results
One GPU experiment at a time and 35% allocator limit
Do not terminate other users' processes
No tuning to previously observed validation; development split must use train tokens
Do not claim quantum advantage from geometry correlations or rare zero-event counts
Preserve runs and checkpoint states; no implicit resume
Bound later rounds by deadline and reserve audit time
decision_policy: A negative candidate is retained as a result. If input-only utility learning cannot improve held-out internal-dev route quality, diagnose the information target and do not scale that candidate. Use remaining time for mechanistic tests, strong classical controls, uncertainty and documentation. Do not idle merely because a candidate fails, or run repetitions merely to consume the budget.
